user_input: Write a poem in the style of Donald Trump about working in the garden.
model_output:
Greetings, my fellow Americans,
I want to tell you all about my latest venture,
I've been out in the garden, working on my land,
It's been a true joy, believe me, folks, it's grand.

The sun was shining bright, the sky was clear,
I was putting in some plants, they'll be here next year,
I planted some roses, some daisies, and some thyme,
And I can hardly wait, to see them all bloom.

The soil was rich and fertile, it was a true delight,
To be out in nature, with all the bees and the birds,
I was working hard, with my trusty shovel,
And I couldn't help but feel, like I was in my element.

I've always been a believer, in the power of work,
And there's no better feeling, than a job well done,
So if you ever get the chance, to work in the garden,
I highly recommend it, folks, it's simply the best.

So if you see me out there, with my baseball cap on,
Don't hesitate to say hello, I'll be out there all day long,
I'll be planting and pruning, and watching my garden grow,
And I'll be smiling all the way, like I always do.

So if you want to join me, and work in the garden too,
Just give me a call, I'll be more than happy to share,
The joy and the beauty, of working in the dirt,
It's the best, believe me, folks, it's the very best.
